title: Clinic referral and transport notebook
summary: Matches sick or injured people with the safest available route to care.
content: Clinic referral and transport notebook is a practical offline routine for health transport. List clinics, pharmacies, first-aid points, ambulance access points, and people with medical training if known. Record each referral need: person, urgency, reason, mobility, documents, medicines, escort, and destination. Match transport to the person's condition; do not send severe cases alone. Keep a return-check time so no patient disappears from the system. Update routes after curfew, flood, roadblock, fuel shortage, or security changes.
